scope: Independent basis-free quantum variance approach to the full-domain exceptional factor-two EB comparison
overall_status: UNKNOWN: exact reduction and rank-at-most-two proof; neither universal proof nor legal counterexample found

claims.exact_statement: For Q=sum_i w_i |A_i><A_i| positive on traceless Hermitians, the canonical support deficit Tr_HS(Q)-S_d(Q) equals the infimum over pure-state ensembles with barycenter I/d of sum_i w_i times the ensemble-averaged Var(A_i). Hence the all-Q factor-two gate is equivalent to this common-ensemble variance being at most 2 sum_i w_i <A_i,(I-Phi)A_i>_tau.
assumptions: Finite-dimensional unital, trace-preserving, completely positive, Hilbert-Schmidt-self-adjoint Phi
Full Hermitian-domain comparison and exact full-domain canonical EB reduction
One pure-state ensemble shared by every A_i, with barycenter I/d
claims.status: internally derived exact reformulation; general inequality UNKNOWN
claims.novelty_boundary: Reformulation only; does not prove the exceptional factor-two claim or refute it.
claims.costs: Exact finite-dimensional derivation; no acquisition, runtime, or hardware costs claimed.
claims.falsifier: An error in the canonical support/ensemble normalization, barycenter identity, or full-domain separation equivalence invalidates this reformulation.

claims.exact_statement: For a supplied symmetric broadcaster Choi state Omega_RAB with reference and both output marginals I/d, E_Omega[(A_R-A_A)^2]=2<A,(I-Phi)A>_tau for each Hermitian A. Hilbert-Schmidt self-adjoint complete positivity also yields a Hermitian Kraus representation and <A,(I-Phi)A>_tau=(1/2)sum_j ||[H_j,A]||^2_{2,tau} >=0 without assuming Hilbert-Schmidt positivity of Phi.
assumptions: Phi is unital, trace preserving, completely positive, and Hilbert-Schmidt self-adjoint
Omega is the normalized Choi state of the supplied broadcaster and both marginals realize Phi
claims.novelty_boundary: Exact discrepancy identity only; no conversion to a common classical ensemble is established for arbitrary frame rank.
claims.falsifier: A mismatch in Choi transpose, marginal normalization, or Hermitian Kraus decomposition invalidates the identity.

claims.exact_statement: The canonical all-Q support inequality holds for dual rank at most two: rank one follows from pulling an observable's spectral PVM through Phi and an exact scalar-square identity; rank two follows by measuring the two spectral PVMs on separate outputs of the supplied broadcaster and refining the resulting effects.
assumptions: For rank two, a legal supplied broadcaster with the correct equal channel marginals
claims.status: internally proved for rank at most two; does not establish arbitrary rank
claims.novelty_boundary: A bounded-rank gate; no full theorem or counterexample follows.
claims.costs: One broadcaster dual-output measurement with at most d^2 outcomes for rank two.
claims.falsifier: Failure of the spectral-PVM pullback identity or refinement Cauchy-Schwarz step invalidates the bounded-rank proof.

claims.exact_statement: For C_Q=sum_i w_i A_i^2 and beta(Q)=inf over pure psi of sum_i w_i Var_psi(A_i), Z_Q=C_Q-beta(Q)I is feasible for the canonical pure-state moment dual, and S_d(Q)<=Tr_HS(Q)-beta(Q). A legal broadcaster with Tr_HS(Q(I-Phi))<beta(Q)/2 would therefore refute the factor-two target.
assumptions: Positive Q with a finite spectral frame decomposition on traceless Hermitians
A counterexample must separately satisfy the exact broadcaster Choi constraints
claims.status: internally derived one-sided dual filter; no legal witness found
claims.novelty_boundary: Sufficient counterexample filter only; the support upper bound cannot prove the universal support lower bound.
claims.costs: Concrete use requires a certified lower bound on beta(Q); no new optimization or acquisition performed.
claims.falsifier: An error in the pure-state variance inequality or barycenter dual value invalidates the filter.

claims.exact_statement: For qubit Pauli X,Z, each separate canonical support is 1 but the support of Q=|X><X|+|Z><Z| is 1, so canonical support is not additive across positive dual components.
assumptions: Normalized qubit Pauli observables and unrestricted canonical POVMs
claims.novelty_boundary: Obstruction to summing separate scalar proofs only; not a legal channel counterexample.
claims.costs: Exact Bloch-sphere bound; no solver or acquisition.
claims.falsifier: A qubit pure state with x^2+z^2>1 or a POVM scoring above 1 for the combined dual would invalidate the calculation.
